positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Engineer with Wearables / AR organization. I work on Orion and related AR Glasses projects. Responsible for a variety of things across the software stack, including application/system runtime, device networking, application frameworks, prototyping end user experiences, software architecture and design.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Founder of a company that writes software for mobile platforms. Produced the following apps:

-DeekFit Gym (Android, iOS, Windows Phone, web, MacOS)
-DeekFit Sprint (Windows Phone)
-Chore Tracker (Windows Phone, BlackBerry Playbook, Android, iOS)
-Weigh My Pet (Android, iOS)
-Tabata Stopwatch (Windows Phone, Android, BlackBerry 10, iOS, Web)
-Barbell Helper (Windows Phone)
-Battery Widget (Windows Phone)
-Shamrock Shake Finder (Windows, Android, iOS, Web)
-StitchPal (Android, iOS, web)
-Christmas Tree Finder (Android, iOS)
-Turninator (Android, iOS)
-Trips Ahoy (Android, iOS, Web)
-Notepad Classic (Windows)

Apps built with the following client technologies:
- Flutter
- Xamarin Forms
- Xamarin Native
- Android 
- Windows Phone (Silverlight)
- UWP
- Win32

Back end technologies:
- WCF services on Azure
- SQLAzure
- Firebase Cloud Datastore / Blob store / Authentication

positions.title: Principal Software Engineering Manager
positions.description: Head of engineering for GroupMe, including client and server teams. Leading an amazing team of passionate, fast-moving engineers building the next generation of chat and collaboration at Microsoft.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building the next generation of chat at Microsoft! Leading a team of developers across client/server boundaries to build new chat experiences.

During this time, I was the technical lead for GroupMe, the lead developer for the Android app, and the sole developer for the Windows UWP app. In addition, I worked with a small team to pioneer the architecture for Microsoft Teams Consumer, rearchitecting the Android app to handle bimodal enterprise / consumer switching, as well as modifying the middle tier server stack to handle enterprise / consumer modes.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Lead engineer with the GroupMe team, responsible for development of the Android and Windows apps.

- Led a team of experienced engineers in the planning, implementation, testing, release, and maintenance of new features across all platforms
- Redesigned GroupMe from the ground up as a Universal Windows 10 app (UWP)
- Technical Lead for Android and Windows, while also contributing code to iOS, web, and the back end services.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior software developer with the commodities development team. Primarily responsible for a system that provides prices for commodity futures and ETFs in a low-latency automated trading system. Noteworthy accomplishments:

-Reduced average latency by 90% in median cases, 99.99% in edge cases
-Lead a team of engineers that developed new monitoring tools to diagnose the health and performance of the system
-Refactored multiple legacy systems onto a common platform

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
Software Development Engineer for the Engineering team of Windows Azure

-Developed a health monitoring dashboard, with a flexible, widget-based Silverlight front end and a highly scalable WCF back end with multi-tier caching
-Extended and improved an ASP.NET web portal
-Added multithreading support to the Azure unit test framework

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Software Development Engineer for the Ordering Payment Plans team 

-Launched a new Java API that consolidated multiple independant service calls
-Refactored legacy C++ code in the Ordering system
-Designed and implemented substantial improvements to the Ordering Test Framework
-Acted as team's Scrum Master for Agile Engineering

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer for the IS&GS/GSS company

Unclassified work included designing and executing test plans for internal software tools and writing custom components for Unity - a Sharepoint extension for project management and social networking.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software engineer, worked on Darwin Client application, better known as Penny Arcade at Commerce/TD Bank.  Designed Darwin Client 2.0 from the ground up, including requirements, design, implementation, testing, and release.  Added a service-enabled back end which allowed for dynamic updates to ad content, settings, or even the application itself.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Full time internship followed by part time work for the IRT department doing ASP.NET web development, followed by one year of part time work doing ASP.NET development for the DLC
